subject: world_language
concept: Understanding regional dialects or register differences (formal vs. informal) within the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a phrase to whether it's formal or informal register in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student rewrites a sentence to shift its register from informal to formal or vice versa

misconception_flags: uses an informal register in a context that calls for formal language, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
